metadata.title: Comprehensive Index of Textual Genres for SuperCollider LLM Testing
metadata.description: Expanded, deduplicated index of 368 individual atomic textual genres across 10 communicative domains and 31 collections, assembled to diversify and scale the SuperCollider AI Assist test corpus.
research_sources: Douglas Biber & Jesse Egbert — Register, Genre, and CORE Web Register Taxonomy
Brown Corpus, British National Corpus (David Lee Index), GUM Corpus, X-GENRE/GINCO
Wikipedia List of Writing Genres & Poetic Forms

Technical/SDLC (RFC/ADR/PRD/Runbook/Postmortem), Medical Clinical Documentation, Legal/Judicial/Diplomatic, Book Paratext (Genette), Religious/Liturgical, Music/Audio, Gaming/TTRPG, and Lusophone (gêneros textuais) taxonomies

genres.name: Sonnet
genres.description: 14-line lyric poem with a structured rhyme scheme and thematic turn (volta).

genres.name: Haiku
genres.description: Three-line poem (traditionally 5-7-5 morae/syllables) capturing a fleeting sensory or seasonal image.

genres.name: Tanka
genres.description: Five-line Japanese poetic form (5-7-5-7-7 syllables) pairing imagery with emotional reflection.

genres.name: Epic poem
genres.description: Extended narrative poem recounting heroic deeds, cultural origins, or historic voyages.

genres.name: Free verse
genres.description: Poetry without fixed meter or rhyme scheme, shaped by cadence, imagery, and line breaks.

genres.name: Lyric poem
genres.description: Musical, metrical or stanzaic poem expressing personal emotion, interiority, or mood.

genres.name: Narrative poem
genres.description: Verse poem telling a story with characters, setting, and plot progression.

genres.name: Limerick
genres.description: Humorous five-line poem with an AABBA rhyme scheme and anapestic rhythm.

genres.name: Ode
genres.description: Elevated lyric poem praising or meditating upon a person, object, or abstract concept.

genres.name: Slam poetry
genres.description: Performance-oriented spoken-word poem written for competitive live recitation with rhythmic urgency.

genres.name: Elegy
genres.description: Solemn lyric poem mourning loss, death, or the passage of time.

genres.name: Ballad
genres.description: Narrative poem or song in rhythmic quatrains telling a dramatic or folkloric story.

genres.name: Villanelle
genres.description: 19-line fixed form using five tercets, one quatrain, two rhymes, and two alternating refrains.

genres.name: Sestina
genres.description: 39-line unrhymed poem rotating six end-words across six sestets and a three-line envoi.

genres.name: Ghazal
genres.description: Poem of autonomous couplets sharing a strict end-rhyme (qafia) and refrain (radif).

genres.name: Pantoum
genres.description: Interlocking quatrain poem where lines 2 and 4 of each stanza become lines 1 and 3 of the next.

genres.name: Prose poem
genres.description: Poetic text formatted in continuous prose paragraphs while foregrounding rhythm, metaphor, and lyric compression.

genres.name: Concrete / visual poetry
genres.description: Experimental poem whose spatial typography and visual arrangement on the page convey meaning.

genres.name: Acrostic poem
genres.description: Poem in which the initial (or specified) letters of each line spell a word or message.

genres.name: Epigram
genres.description: Brief, witty, or satirical poem ending in a sharp rhetorical turn or punchline.

genres.name: Nursery rhyme
genres.description: Traditional short rhythmic verse or chant passed down for young children.

genres.name: Literatura de cordel
genres.description: Brazilian Northeast pamphlet verse narrative printed in metrical stanzas (e.g., sextilhas) with woodcut covers.

genres.name: Repente (improvised verse duel)
genres.description: Oral improvised poetic challenge sung in strict meter and rhyme between two performers.

genres.name: Haibun
genres.description: Hybrid literary form combining terse prose vignettes with interspersed haiku.

genres.name: Novel
genres.description: Book-length fictional prose narrative developing complex characters, settings, and plot arcs.

genres.name: Novella
genres.description: Mid-length fictional narrative longer than a short story and more focused than a novel.

genres.name: Short story
genres.description: Self-contained brief fictional narrative centered on a single conflict, moment, or revelation.

genres.name: Flash fiction
genres.description: Ultra-brief fictional story typically under 1,000 words delivering a complete narrative arc.

genres.name: Drabble (100-word microfiction)
genres.description: Microfiction constrained to an exact word count (traditionally 100 words).

genres.name: Fable
genres.description: Brief allegorical story, often featuring anthropomorphized animals, concluding with an explicit moral.

genres.name: Fairy tale
genres.description: Folkloric or literary wonder tale involving magic, archetypes, and symbolic trials.

genres.name: Myth
genres.description: Traditional sacred or cosmological narrative explaining origins, deities, and natural forces.

genres.name: Legend
genres.description: Traditional narrative anchored in historical time or place and embellished with extraordinary events.

genres.name: Allegory
genres.description: Narrative in which characters, objects, and events systematically symbolize abstract moral or political ideas.

genres.name: Folktale
genres.description: Orally transmitted secular traditional tale reflecting communal customs and motifs.

genres.name: Tall tale
genres.description: Humorous narrative built around outrageous exaggeration told in a deadpan voice.

genres.name: Parable
genres.description: Succinct didactic story grounded in everyday human situations to illustrate an ethical or spiritual principle.

genres.name: Epistolary fiction
genres.description: Narrative told entirely through exchanged letters, diary entries, emails, or documents.

genres.name: Satire
genres.description: Fictional or ironic text using exaggeration, parody, and wit to critique social or political folly.

genres.name: Parody
genres.description: Imitative work mimicking the style and conventions of another text or genre for comic or critical effect.

genres.name: Literary vignette
genres.description: Brief evocative sketch capturing a mood, character, or scene without a conventional plot arc.

genres.name: Urban legend
genres.description: Modern folkloric cautionary or eerie story circulating as an allegedly true secondhand account.

genres.name: Interactive branching fiction
genres.description: Second-person narrative structured into numbered nodes with reader choices determining outcomes.

genres.name: Memoir
genres.description: First-person non-fiction narrative centered on specific themes, eras, or turning points in the author's life.

genres.name: Autobiography
genres.description: Comprehensive chronological account of a person's life written by the subject.

genres.name: Biography
genres.description: Researched non-fiction narrative chronicling another person's life and historical context.

genres.name: Personal essay
genres.description: Reflective prose piece exploring an idea or memory through the author's subjective lens.

genres.name: Travelogue
genres.description: Narrative account of journeys, places, and cultural encounters written from firsthand observation.

genres.name: Travel guide
genres.description: Practical descriptive and advisory text outlining destinations, itineraries, and cultural tips.

genres.name: Literary journalism
genres.description: Fact-checked investigative reporting written with narrative scene-setting and literary prose.

genres.name: Diary / journal entry
genres.description: Dated personal record of daily events, thoughts, and private reflections.

genres.name: Crônica (literary chronicle)
genres.description: Short Lusophone/Latin American prose genre blending everyday observation with lyricism, humor, or social critique.

genres.name: True crime narrative
genres.description: Non-fiction account reconstructing an actual criminal investigation, motive, and trial.

genres.name: Oral history transcript
genres.description: Verbatim or lightly edited transcript of a recorded interview preserving lived historical memory.

genres.name: Tragedy play
genres.description: Dramatic stage script depicting a serious conflict leading to catastrophe or moral reckoning.

genres.name: Comedy play
genres.description: Dramatic stage script structured around wit, social misunderstandings, and a restorative resolution.

genres.name: Farce
genres.description: Fast-paced comedic play built on improbable situations, physical humor, and exaggerated stereotypes.

genres.name: Tragicomedy
genres.description: Dramatic work blending grave emotional stakes with comedic irony or relief.

genres.name: Melodrama
genres.description: Theatrical or broadcast drama emphasizing heightened emotion, moral polarization, and sensational plot twists.

genres.name: Dramatic verse / auto
genres.description: Staged or declamatory drama written in verse, rooted in medieval and Iberian/Brazilian dramatic traditions.

genres.name: Movie script (screenplay)
genres.description: Formatted film script specifying sluglines, action description, character cues, and dialogue.

genres.name: Television script (teleplay)
genres.description: Episodic script structured around act breaks, cold opens, and series continuity.

genres.name: Radio play / audio drama script
genres.description: Script crafted purely for sound, indicating dialogue, acoustic perspective, foley, and music cues.

genres.name: Monologue
genres.description: Extended uninterrupted speech delivered by a single dramatic character.

genres.name: Soliloquy
genres.description: Dramatic speech spoken aloud by a character alone on stage to reveal inner thoughts.

genres.name: Stage directions
genres.description: Paratextual theatrical instructions specifying blocking, lighting, sound, props, and actor delivery.

genres.name: Film treatment / logline
genres.description: Prose blueprint summarizing a screenplay's premise, character arcs, and scene progression.

genres.name: Comic book script
genres.description: Page-and-panel script specifying visual framing, sound effects (SFX), captions, and speech balloons.

genres.name: Graphic novel script
genres.description: Long-form sequential art script orchestrating multi-chapter visual pacing and layout.

genres.name: Storyboard text
genres.description: Shot-by-shot captioning describing camera movement, action beats, and audio sync under visual frames.

genres.name: Manga / webtoon script
genres.description: Sequential script tailored to vertical scroll or right-to-left page turns and kinetic paneling.

genres.name: Book blurb (back-cover copy)
genres.pt_br_name: Texto de quarta capa / sinopse editorial
genres.description: Promotional summary on a book jacket or listing designed to entice readers without spoiling the ending.

genres.name: Foreword
genres.description: Introductory essay written by someone other than the author contextualizing or endorsing the work.

genres.name: Preface
genres.description: Author's introductory note explaining the book's origin, scope, methodology, and acknowledgments.

genres.name: Afterword / epilogue note
genres.description: Concluding commentary reflecting on a work's creation, aftermath, or historical reception.

genres.name: Dedication
genres.description: Brief personal inscription offering a published work to specific people or causes.

genres.name: Epigraph
genres.description: Short quotation placed at the opening of a book or chapter to foreshadow theme or tone.

genres.name: Colophon
genres.description: Publishing note detailing production metadata, typography, paper, printer, and edition run.

genres.name: Errata sheet
genres.description: Printed or digital list correcting typographical or factual errors discovered after publication.

genres.name: Empirical academic paper
genres.description: IMRaD-structured scholarly article reporting original experimental, observational, or corpus data.

genres.name: Theoretical academic paper
genres.description: Scholarly paper advancing conceptual models, formal frameworks, or interpretive syntheses.

genres.name: Dissertation
genres.description: Book-length original doctoral research monograph defending an independent scholarly contribution.

genres.name: Thesis
genres.description: Formal graduate research manuscript demonstrating mastery of methodology and original analysis.

genres.name: Literature review
genres.description: Scholarly synthesis mapping themes, debates, and gaps across existing published research.

genres.name: Systematic review
genres.description: Protocol-driven synthesis using explicit search, inclusion, and bias-assessment criteria.

genres.name: Meta-analysis
genres.description: Quantitative synthesis pooling statistical effect sizes across multiple independent studies.

genres.name: Academic abstract
genres.description: Dense single-paragraph summary stating objective, method, key findings, and significance.

genres.name: Conference proceedings paper
genres.description: Concise peer-reviewed scholarly paper formatted for archival conference publication.

genres.name: Grant proposal
genres.description: Persuasive technical proposal justifying research aims, methodology, timeline, and budget to funders.

genres.name: Rebuttal / response to reviewers
genres.description: Point-by-point scholarly response addressing peer-review critiques and documenting manuscript revisions.

genres.name: Erratum / corrigendum
genres.description: Formal journal notice correcting data, equations, or attributions in a published article.

genres.name: Technical / scientific report
genres.description: Detailed institutional research report documenting experiments, engineering benchmarks, or measurements.

genres.name: Mathematical proof
genres.description: Deductive chain of definitions, axioms, lemmas, and logical steps establishing a theorem.

genres.name: Morphological description
genres.description: Precise anatomical or linguistic specification of form, structure, and diagnostic traits.

genres.name: Biology text
genres.description: Scientific exposition of cellular, physiological, genetic, or ecological processes.

genres.name: Taxonomy / classification entry
genres.description: Hierarchical biological or bibliographic classification detailing diagnostic keys and nomenclature.

genres.name: Ethnography
genres.description: Qualitative anthropological study interpreting cultural practices from participant observation.

genres.name: Field notes
genres.description: Raw, timestamped observational notes recorded in situ during ecological, linguistic, or ethnographic fieldwork.

genres.name: Lab notebook entry
genres.description: Dated experimental log capturing hypotheses, reagent quantities, instrument settings, and raw observations.

genres.name: Philosophical treatise
genres.description: Systematic long-form argument examining metaphysics, epistemology, ethics, or aesthetics.

genres.name: Philosophical dialogue
genres.description: Dialectical exploration of ideas staged as a structured conversation between interlocutors.

genres.name: Aphorism / maxim
genres.description: Terse, memorable statement distilling a philosophical, moral, or psychological observation.

genres.name: Historical monograph
genres.description: Focused scholarly book or study investigating a specific historical period, institution, or event.

genres.name: Historical chronicle
genres.description: Sequential narrative record of events arranged chronologically, often blending state records and witness lore.

genres.name: Annal
genres.description: Terse year-by-year historical record noting major political, climatic, or social events.

genres.name: Archaeological site report
genres.description: Stratigraphic and artifact-catalog report documenting excavation trenches, dating, and context.

genres.name: Textbook chapter
genres.description: Structured instructional exposition with learning objectives, worked examples, and review exercises.

genres.name: Study guide
genres.description: Condensed review document synthesizing key concepts, formulas, and practice prompts for learners.

genres.name: Course syllabus
genres.description: Academic contract outlining course objectives, weekly schedule, readings, policies, and grading breakdown.

genres.name: Lecture notes
genres.description: Structured summary or transcript of classroom exposition, proofs, and diagrams.

genres.name: Academic poster
genres.description: Modular visual-textual summary presenting a study's question, method, charts, and conclusions.

genres.name: Lesson plan
genres.description: Teacher's operational blueprint detailing learning goals, timing, activities, and materials.

genres.name: Exam / quiz
genres.description: Assessment instrument composed of prompts, multiple-choice stems, or problems testing comprehension.

genres.name: Grading rubric
genres.description: Matrix defining performance criteria and qualitative descriptors across achievement levels.

genres.name: Study flashcard
genres.description: Micro-pedagogical cue-and-answer pair optimized for spaced-repetition recall.

genres.name: Fichamento (analytical reading card)
genres.description: Structured study note extracting citations, paraphrases, bibliographic metadata, and critical comments.

genres.name: Academic memorial
genres.description: First-person analytical dossier recounting a scholar's intellectual trajectory and contributions.

genres.name: Peer review report
genres.description: Confidential scholarly evaluation assessing a manuscript's validity, novelty, and methodological rigor.

genres.name: Case study
genres.description: In-depth contextual analysis of a single organization, clinical patient, system, or event.

genres.name: Academic book review
genres.description: Critical appraisal summarizing a scholarly book's thesis, evidence, and contribution to its field.

genres.name: Resenha crítica (critical synthesis)
genres.description: Structured Portuguese/academic review pairing concise summary with evaluative judgment.

genres.name: Annotated bibliography
genres.description: Formatted citation list in which each entry is followed by a descriptive and evaluative paragraph.

genres.name: Literary criticism essay
genres.description: Close-reading analytical essay interpreting a literary text's form, intertextuality, or historical meaning.

genres.name: SOAP note
genres.description: Structured clinical progress note organized into Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan sections.

genres.name: Triage note
genres.pt_br_name: Nota de triagem / classificação de risco
genres.description: Rapid intake record capturing chief complaint, vital signs, and acuity level in emergency care.

genres.name: Hospital discharge summary
genres.description: Comprehensive transition-of-care report summarizing inpatient course, diagnoses, and follow-up plan.

genres.name: Pathology report
genres.description: Diagnostic laboratory report detailing gross and microscopic findings of excised tissue or biopsy.

genres.name: Radiology / imaging report
genres.description: Structured diagnostic interpretation of medical imaging detailing technique, findings, and impression.

genres.name: Medical prescription
genres.description: Formal clinical order specifying medication, dosage, route, frequency, and duration.

genres.name: Clinical referral letter
genres.description: Inter-clinician communication summarizing patient history and reason for specialist consultation.

genres.name: Informed consent form
genres.pt_br_name: Termo de consentimento livre e esclarecido (TCLE)
genres.description: Accessible legal-medical document explaining procedure or trial risks, benefits, and patient rights.

genres.name: Patient information leaflet / bula
genres.pt_br_name: Bula de medicamento / folheto ao paciente
genres.description: Regulated instructional text detailing indications, posology, contraindications, and adverse effects.

genres.name: Clinical trial protocol
genres.description: Rigorous scientific and ethical blueprint governing study arms, endpoints, and safety monitoring.

genres.name: Clinical study report (CSR)
genres.description: Regulatory dossier presenting full statistical and safety outcomes of a clinical trial.

genres.name: Clinical case vignette
genres.description: Concise patient presentation used in medical education and board exams to test diagnostic reasoning.

genres.name: Source code
genres.description: Executable programming language instructions with declarations, control flow, and symbolic identifiers.

genres.name: Shell / automation script
genres.description: Task-oriented script orchestrating CLI tools, pipelines, or system administration.

genres.name: API documentation
genres.description: Reference specification detailing endpoints, signatures, parameters, return types, and error codes.

genres.name: README file
genres.description: Repository entry-point guide summarizing purpose, installation, usage examples, and license.

genres.name: Software release notes
genres.description: User-facing announcement highlighting new capabilities, breaking changes, and upgrade steps.

genres.name: Changelog
genres.description: Chronological versioned log categorizing Added, Changed, Deprecated, Fixed, and Security items.

genres.name: Request for Comments (RFC) / design doc
genres.description: Technical proposal soliciting engineering review on architecture, trade-offs, and migration plans.

genres.name: Architecture Decision Record (ADR)
genres.description: Immutable concise record capturing an architectural choice, its context, and consequences.

genres.name: Product Requirements Document (PRD)
genres.description: Product specification defining problem statement, user stories, scope, non-goals, and KPIs.

genres.name: Runbook / operational playbook
genres.description: Step-by-step SRE/DevOps procedure for routine maintenance, scaling, and alert triage.

genres.name: Incident postmortem
genres.description: Blameless retrospective analyzing outage timeline, root causes, impact, and corrective actions.

genres.name: Bug report / issue ticket
genres.description: Structured defect report stating environment, reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior.

genres.name: Git commit message
genres.description: Concise imperative header and rationale explaining what a code diff changes and why.

genres.name: Pull request description
genres.description: Summary of code changes, test evidence, and review checklist accompanying a merge proposal.

genres.name: Code review comment
genres.description: Targeted inline feedback raising correctness, readability, or security observations on a diff.

genres.name: Stack trace / system error log
genres.description: Timestamped diagnostic telemetry and call-stack dump emitted during runtime execution or failure.

genres.name: Configuration file / data schema
genres.description: Declarative structured text (JSON/YAML/TOML/SQL DDL) specifying parameters or data constraints.

genres.name: Docstring / inline code comment
genres.description: Embedded explanatory annotation clarifying function contracts, invariants, or non-obvious rationale.

genres.name: AI system prompt / prompt template
genres.pt_br_name: Prompt de sistema / template de IA
genres.description: Instructional specification defining an LLM's persona, constraints, tool rules, and output schema.

genres.name: Technical white paper
genres.description: Authoritative technical or industry report explaining a complex architecture, standard, or solution.

genres.name: Synthesizer manual
genres.description: Instrument manual detailing signal flow, oscillators, modulation matrix, MIDI CC maps, and patch recipes.

genres.name: User guide
genres.description: Task-oriented product manual walking end users through features, workflows, and settings.

genres.name: Maintenance manual
genres.description: Technical service guide covering preventive inspection schedules, calibration, and part replacement.

genres.name: Installation guide
genres.description: Sequential setup instructions covering prerequisites, dependencies, configuration, and verification.

genres.name: Troubleshooting matrix
genres.description: Diagnostic symptom-cause-remedy table or decision tree for isolating faults.

genres.name: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
genres.description: Question-and-answer reference addressing common user doubts, edge cases, and policies.

genres.name: Instructions for Use (IFU)
genres.description: Regulated step-by-step operating and safety instructions for hardware or medical devices.

genres.name: Quickstart guide
genres.description: Minimal-friction walkthrough getting a user from zero to a working outcome in minutes.

genres.name: Step-by-step tutorial / how-to guide
genres.description: Guided practical walkthrough teaching a specific technique or project build.

genres.name: Culinary recipe
genres.description: Procedural culinary text pairing quantified ingredients and equipment with sequential preparation steps.

genres.name: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
genres.description: Controlled organizational directive specifying exact steps, roles, and safety checks for repeatable tasks.

genres.name: Blueprint / schematic annotation
genres.description: Concise callout text labeling dimensions, tolerances, materials, and wiring on technical drawings.

genres.name: Safety Data Sheet (SDS)
genres.pt_br_name: Ficha de Segurança de Produto Químico (FISPQ/FDS)
genres.description: Standardized 16-section chemical hazard, handling, PPE, and first-aid reference document.

genres.name: Emergency protocol
genres.description: High-clarity imperative checklist governing immediate response to fire, medical, or containment crises.

genres.name: Assembly instructions
genres.description: Part-numbered sequential steps guiding physical construction of furniture, kits, or equipment.

genres.name: Warranty statement / card
genres.description: Consumer notice specifying coverage period, exclusions, and repair/replacement claim procedures.

genres.name: Game rulebook
genres.description: Structured specification of setup, turn order, legal moves, edge cases, and victory conditions.

genres.name: Song lyrics
genres.description: Verse-chorus-bridge vocal text written to fit musical phrasing, meter, and prosody.

genres.name: Libretto
genres.description: Complete sung and spoken text of an opera, oratorio, or musical theater work.

genres.name: Musical composition exercise
genres.description: Pedagogical prompt or constrained task in counterpoint, orchestration, or algorithmic synthesis.

genres.name: Music pedagogy text
genres.description: Instructional explanation of music theory, ear training, acoustics, or instrumental technique.

genres.name: Sheet music annotation
genres.description: Score markings indicating tempo, dynamics, articulation, fingering, bowing, or expressive character.

genres.name: Synth patch notes / preset description
genres.pt_br_name: Notas de patch / descrição de preset
genres.description: Textual documentation of oscillator, filter, envelope, and modulation routing for a sound design patch.

genres.name: Field recording log
genres.description: Phonography metadata log recording microphone array, coordinates, weather, time, and acoustic events.

genres.name: Audio / music cue sheet
genres.description: Timecoded production log listing every music track, sound effect, duration, and rights usage.

genres.name: Album liner notes
genres.description: Contextual essay, track commentary, and session credits accompanying a recorded album release.

genres.name: Lead sheet / chord chart
genres.description: Compact musical notation pairing lyric lines or melody cues with chord symbols and form markers.

genres.name: Opera / ballet synopsis
genres.description: Act-by-act narrative summary preparing audiences for a staged musical work.

genres.name: Exhibition catalog essay
genres.description: Curatorial essay and object entries situating artworks within art-historical themes.

genres.name: Artist statement
genres.description: First-person reflective prose articulating an artist's medium, process, and conceptual inquiry.

genres.name: Concert / performance program notes
genres.description: Audience guide detailing repertoire history, compositional structure, and biographical context.

genres.name: Art manifesto
genres.description: Polemical public declaration proclaiming aesthetic principles and rejecting inherited conventions.

genres.name: Art / theater critical review
genres.description: Evaluative essay analyzing an exhibition, stage production, or architectural work.

genres.name: Choreography / movement notation notes
genres.description: Descriptive or symbolic text recording spatial pathways, timing, and bodily movement sequences.

genres.name: Museum / gallery wall label
genres.description: Ultra-concise interpretive plaque placed beside an artifact or artwork in an exhibition.

genres.name: News article
genres.description: Inverted-pyramid factual report answering who, what, when, where, why, and how on recent events.

genres.name: Breaking news alert
genres.description: Single-sentence urgent dispatch summarizing an unfolding major news event.

genres.name: Feature story
genres.description: Long-form journalistic article exploring human interest, context, and narrative depth.

genres.name: Investigative report
genres.description: Evidence-backed exposé uncovering systemic misconduct through documents, data, and interviews.

genres.name: Live blog update
genres.description: Reverse-chronological timestamped dispatches covering an ongoing crisis, trial, or live event.

genres.name: Press release
genres.description: Official media announcement formatted with headline, dateline, quote, and boilerplate.

genres.name: Obituary
genres.description: Biographical notice commemorating a deceased person's life, achievements, and survivors.

genres.name: Sports recap
genres.description: Post-game journalistic report summarizing turning points, key plays, and final standings.

genres.name: Sports play-by-play commentary
genres.description: Real-time action commentary translating fast-moving athletic events into vivid speech or text.

genres.name: Sports box score / match summary
genres.description: Structured statistical summary of player stats, scoring intervals, and team totals.

genres.name: Q&A interview / profile
genres.description: Edited dialogue or narrative portrait exploring a subject's ideas, career, and voice.

genres.name: News explainer
genres.description: Accessible Q&A or modular breakdown unpacking the background of a complex current event.

genres.name: Fact-check article
genres.description: Claim-by-claim verification report evaluating public statements against primary evidence.

genres.name: Weather forecast
genres.description: Concise meteorological bulletin stating temperature ranges, precipitation probability, wind, and alerts.

genres.name: Horoscope
genres.description: Formulaic astrological prediction addressed to zodiac signs with advice on mood, work, and love.

genres.name: Editorial
genres.description: Unsigned institutional opinion article expressing a publication's official stance.

genres.name: Op-ed
genres.description: Signed guest commentary presenting an argument on public policy or culture.

genres.name: Newspaper / magazine column
genres.description: Recurring signed commentary showcasing a writer's distinctive voice and recurring beat.

genres.name: Letter to the editor
genres.description: Brief reader submission responding to previously published journalism or public debate.

genres.name: Movie review
genres.description: Evaluative film critique assessing screenplay, direction, cinematography, and performance without spoilers.

genres.name: Music / album review
genres.description: Critical review analyzing sonic production, songwriting, genre lineage, and artistic impact.

genres.name: Concert review
genres.description: Journalistic evaluation of a live musical performance, setlist, acoustics, and audience rapport.

genres.name: Restaurant review
genres.description: Sensory and service evaluation covering menu execution, ambiance, pacing, and value.

genres.name: Political cartoon caption
genres.description: Pithy satirical line or dialogue pairing with editorial caricature.

genres.name: Satirical news article
genres.description: Deadpan parody mimicking straight wire-service journalism to lampoon absurdities.

genres.name: User / consumer product review
genres.description: Firsthand customer rating and commentary detailing durability, pros, cons, and use cases.

genres.name: Advertorial
genres.description: Sponsored editorial-style article promoting a brand or product via storytelling.

genres.name: Advertisement copy
genres.description: Persuasive commercial copy crafted to capture attention and trigger desire or purchase.

genres.name: E-commerce product description
genres.description: Benefit-driven catalog text combining specs, use cases, and sensory detail.

genres.name: Tagline / brand slogan
genres.description: Ultra-short memorable phrase distilling a brand's promise or identity.

genres.name: Brochure / pamphlet copy
genres.description: Structured multi-panel marketing overview highlighting services, value propositions, and contacts.

genres.name: Press kit / media kit
